system.description:
Big Bad Beater. +1 Talent Die on Strikes against enemies with a Red or Black Deathcon rating.

Destined (Flaw). In Combat Encounters and chases, enemies with a Red or Black Deathcon rating always target you unless they are distracted.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.94
